about: A 'current' fact that changed after the models' training: on 2026-11-13 the Active LTS is Node 26 (v26.13.1, nodejs.org/dist/index.json); Opus and Sonnet said v24, from memory or from old pages, partly because think() never told them the date (#14). The check fails a v24 answer. Update it when Node 28 goes LTS (October 2027).
